blocks.text: The Kahloor force turns from direct testing to ritual and night plotting, hoping that deities, offerings, and secret effort will succeed where arms and hands have failed.
Yet the emblem remains fixed, the attempted cuts or removals fail, and the chiefs are left ashamed before what they cannot master.
This page is about the unraveling of the Kahloor force’s confidence before a sign that resists both muscle and ritual.
